title: Materials
description: The materials the warehouse stores, receives and ships. The code never changes; the barcode is the code unless another is given.

form.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later.
form.name: Name
form.barcodeHint: Left empty, the material's code is used.

confirm.deactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? It will not be offered for new records, it stays in history, and its barcode becomes free.

importPage.title: Import inventory
importPage.description: Loads the materials of the inventory file (.xlsx). The file is reviewed first, without saving anything; then you confirm the import of the same file. Stock is loaded later, with the opening inventory.

control.label: Control total
control.matches: The stock adds up ({{stock}}) to the control total ({{control}}).
control.mismatch: The stock ({{stock}}) does not add up to the control total ({{control}}). It cannot be imported.
control.none: The file carries no control total.

importPage.done: {{created}} new materials were imported. {{existing}} were already there.
importPage.nothingNew: No new materials: they were all there already.
